notes.title: Freshly Frosted Needs You!
notes.content:
Freshly Frosted Needs You!

Freshly Frosted has made it to the finals of AT&T Unlocked Games, a showcase spotlighting women leading the development of indie games! As you might already know, Freshly Frosted is a title we’re developing entirely in-house. Relax with the beautiful pastel colors and delightful donuts, all while enjoying an upbeat soundtrack. 

We’ve been working on this for years, and we’ve recently added new donut shapes, audio, and dozens of new levels; we can’t wait for you to see them. Starting today, there will be a demo for Freshly Frosted available for the next 24 hours - it’s got all kinds of neat new features so don’t miss it!

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1660103217220896614/0F448261BABD01B2F9079E373526152E42B1313C/

We’ve got a lot of perfect little pastries we’d like to show you live on stream today at 6PM PST on the AT&T Unlocked Games stream at http://twitch.tv/eleagueTV. The AT&T Unlocked Games showcase is going to be hosted by Annemunition and Bnans, two incredibly successful streamers from Twitch! You’ll be able to see more from Freshly Frosted during this stream, and that’s followed by a 24 hour voting period where you can win a lifetime supply of high fives by voting for us as Gamers Choice!

HERE’S HOW YOU CAN HELP US WIN!


Vote for Freshly Frosted for Gamers Choice between today at 6PM PST and tomorrow at 6PM PST here!
 

One of the reasons we’re so excited about being included in this contest is because we’ll have a shot at securing more funding for Freshly Frosted by winning the Gamers Choice award! Winning means we would have more to work with to make the game great, and we’d love to show the game off to even more people. We’re counting on you to pick us so that we can deliver the best little donut factory that there’s ever been

Now get out there and vote!
